def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    print("doc:", doc.name)
    des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    root = des.rootComponent
    out = []
    for b in root.bRepBodies:
        out.append(("body", b.name, b.boundingBox.minPoint.asArray(), b.boundingBox.maxPoint.asArray()))
    for f in root.bRepBodies[0].faces:
        g = f.geometry
        t = type(g).__name__
        if t in ('Cylinder','Sphere','Cone','Torus'):
            out.append((t, f.boundingBox.minPoint.asArray(), f.boundingBox.maxPoint.asArray(), f.area))
    for o in out: print(o)
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    print("cam:", cam)
    for s in cam.setups:
        print("setup", s.name, s.operations.count, s.machine.vendor if s.machine else None)
    print("libs")
    return None
